result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like medians or curb extensions result in significant exposure for pedestrians during crossings.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main roadway increases the duration pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main thoroughfare in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk and traffic signals, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads and refuge islands. The environment is dominated by wide asphalt surfaces and a large commercial driveway, which increases pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island increase the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Large Corner Radii
hazards.description: The wide, sweeping corner near the gas station entrance encourages higher vehicle turning speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the Mobil station

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down right-turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island for protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide turning radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed right turns by vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads and refuge islands for a wide multi-lane crossing.
